metadata.quantization: simulated quantization: quantize -> dequantize -> BF16 -> F.linear for MoE expert weights; FP32 logits and loss
metadata.experiment: Iteration 20 router-rank preservation via inverse-gap weighted routing counts and router-affinity channel scores

routergap_joint_topup_3pct.description: Gap-aware joint three-tier plan: rebucket experts with gap-weighted routing counts and rank medium-tier W1/W2 channels by inverse-gap router-affinity at 3% topup.

routergap_joint_topup_5pct.description: Gap-aware joint three-tier plan: rebucket experts with gap-weighted routing counts and rank medium-tier W1/W2 channels by inverse-gap router-affinity at 5% topup.

routergap_joint_topup_8pct.description: Gap-aware joint three-tier plan: rebucket experts with gap-weighted routing counts and rank medium-tier W1/W2 channels by inverse-gap router-affinity at 8% topup.

routergap_union_topup_5pct.description: Union the MxMoE block base and joint three-tier base, then replace router-affinity topups with inverse-gap router-affinity on every remaining FP4 W1/W2 path.

routergap_mxmoe_topup_8pct.description: Keep the MxMoE block projection base and replace activation-kurtosis topups with inverse-gap router-affinity ranking at 8% on non-promoted W1/W2 paths.

routergap_perchannel_20pct.description: Pure per-channel plan with a 1:4 W1:W2 split: allocate expert budgets by inverse-gap routing counts and rank channels by inverse-gap router-affinity.
